data.narrative: Learner demonstrated exemplary command of the debugging toolbox throughout Module 04, successfully transitioning from code reading to runtime instrumentation. Using memory profiling and query logs, the student reproduced and resolved Bug #6 (connection pool leak on error paths) via guaranteed finally block cleanup and Bug #7 (N+1 query loop on /links) via eager batch loading. When challenged with a CPU spike in the break step, the student isolated Catastrophic Backtracking (ReDoS) and replaced vulnerable nested quantifiers with deterministic WHATWG standard parsing.

dimension_scores.observation: Selected Manual Profiling and Targeted Inspection (Option B/B) with clear architectural reasoning, articulating how runtime inspection avoids vendor agent overhead while focused profiling minimizes noise.
dimension_scores.evidence: Justified choosing memory profiling for gradual multi-hour degradation due to GC pressure, and proved why caching an N+1 query is a band-aid while eager loading fixes root cause.

dimension_scores.observation: Refused to guess or rely on syntax inspections, instead utilizing heap tracking, query count telemetry, and CPU profiling to observe true runtime behavior.
dimension_scores.evidence: Proved that 51 SQL queries executed for 50 rows despite ORM config declaring 'eager', and isolated ReDoS event loop blocking using CPU flame analysis.

dimension_scores.observation: Identified and neutralized Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS / CWE-1333) in URL validation, recognizing that unconstrained nested quantifiers enable algorithmic complexity attacks.
dimension_scores.evidence: Replaced regexes with O(N) WHATWG standard URL parser and enforced 2,048-character input bounds, reducing pathological payload latency from >45s to 88ms.

dimension_scores.observation: Addressed edge-case resource leaks on exception paths, proving that production reliability depends on deterministic finally cleanup when 10% of requests encounter transient errors.
dimension_scores.evidence: Demonstrated that missing finally blocks exhausted a 10-connection pool after 10 errors, whereas safe finally blocks ran 2,000 operations with 200 errors with 0 leaks.

dimension_scores.observation: Documented full diagnostic notebook in progress/module-04-diagnosis.md with SQL query plans, heap state metrics, and benchmark telemetry.
dimension_scores.evidence: Clearly explained why code reading failed to detect ORM version drift and why finally blocks guarantee release across unhandled exceptions.

strengths: Mastery of profiling tools: leverages query logging, heap metrics, and CPU flame analysis rather than relying on misleading code blueprints
